name: 72fm-radio
description: Claude plugin: search internet radio stations and get stream URLs (Radio Browser data). By 72FM.

scripts.build: esbuild server/index.js --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/server.mjs --log-level=warning
